name: Yhwach

status: Sealed as the New Soul King

power.name: The Almighty (Schrift A)
power.notes: Sees all possible futures and rewrites future reality; redistributes and absorbs all Quincy souls through Auswählen.

powerSteps.title: Schrift A

powerSteps.name: Auswählen
powerSteps.desc: Beams down columns of holy light that strip power and life from lower Quincy across realms to resurrect his inner circle.

powerSteps.desc: Consumes the core torso of the Soul King, gaining power to dissolve the barriers dividing Hueco Mundo, Soul Society, and the Living World.
